boundaries.note: Virsliga 10th is relegated directly and 9th plays a two-legged play-off against the 2nd-placed Future League club for the last place; the Future League champion is promoted directly. One shared play-off place, so the real movement is between 1+1 and 2+2 each way.

conflicts: The 2026 Virsliga infobox says 170 matches, but 10 clubs playing four rounds is 180; the round count (four rounds, 36 per club) is stated in prose and matches the LFF regulations cited there, so 36 is used.

Our row's name 'Futbola Pirmā līga' is the pre-2021 name: the second tier has been branded Nakotnes liga / Future League since 2021 and LVBET League for sponsorship in 2026. Same competition, id unchanged.
notes: Calendar-year season (6 March - 8 November 2026). Virsliga: 10 clubs, four rounds = 36 matches each; champion RFS, Ogre United relegated. Future League: 14 clubs, double round-robin = 26 matches; champion promoted, 2nd into the play-off, bottom two relegated to the Second League (LIIGA) and 3rd-from-bottom into a play-off with the Second League 3rd. So the second tier's own relegation is a 2+1 structure. The 2026 Virsliga article is tagged AI-generated but its structure matches the LFF regulations it cites and the league article.
